scientific_integrity: The tilted Markov generator and independent phase-modulus derivative establish the counting theorem; finite numeric checks corroborate but do not replace proofs. No unperformed external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-state Markov telegraph noise with positive jump rates. The inverse-asymmetry count requires fixed strong coupling. The closed coherence formula is previously known. Unlocated special-function or Markov-additive literature could contain an equivalent counting theorem.
title: Zero avoidance and inverse-asymmetry revival counting for stationary telegraph dephasing
